task: Require standards-based loudness-target evidence and limiter gain-reduction budgets before a mastering candidate can advance
contract: Configured LUFS targets require pyloudnorm integrated-LUFS evidence; an RMS approximation cannot satisfy the target gate.
A configured loudness target outside the configured tolerance rejects the candidate.
When the maximizer is enabled, final and per-band gain-reduction evidence is mandatory.
The default final limiter GR budget is 3.0 dB and the default worst-band limiter GR budget is 4.0 dB; exceeding either rejects the candidate.
Machine-safe mastering remains pending_human_review and baseline_eligible=false until level-matched human listening accepts it.

current_cleanup_baseline.note: Balance-transparent Ptitsa cleanup remains outside the accepted baseline until human RAW/CLEAN listening accepts it, especially both vocals.

next_studio_goal.task: Add a bounded mastering target controller that approaches configured LUFS by distributing gain and drive without violating true-peak, final-limiter or per-band GR budgets; rejected candidates must roll back and subjective acceptance remains human.
